## Description

Excavator hydraulic return oil filter for the SK130-8, OE P502561. The source confirms the excavator application and the return-filter position but the parameters are reference-grade figures to verify on the spec sheet. Return-line duty follows the return flow, so flow-rate and cleanliness-target inputs decide the correct element. We recommend providing those inputs, stating the ISO 4406 target, and requesting pressure-drop and beta-ratio data for the circuit before ordering.
